text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman Akikawa entrusted me with a 
project to attract fans to "Dream Fest." 
Ever since, I've been brainstorming social 
media campaigns, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've been agonizing over it, unable to 
come up with a good idea... How can we 
draw people with no interest into races...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I have finished my bodyweight training.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I wonder what she's groaning about?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I see. So you're struggling to brainstorm 
ideas...
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I was just wondering what might draw 
people in.

Yeah, I'm wondering what would draw people 
in.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
What a foolish question. The answer is 
power—power that overwhelms all else.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Desiring to know who is the strongest is 
an instinct inherent to all living beings, 
is it not?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, we are in the middle of 
training right now. Save your worrying for 
later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Switching gears, I focused entirely on 
training. Then, along the mountain path—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...What an eyesore.
choice_data_list:
A pile of oversized garbage... Illegal 
dumping, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. We can't get through like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Muttering those words, Gentildonna strode 
up to a pile of trash taller than herself. 
She placed her hand on its peak, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(SNAP CRACK...!) (CREAAAK...!) 
(SQUEEEEZE~!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Is this about right, I wonder?
choice_data_list:
(T-The pile of trash was completely 
compressed...!?)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
What are you daydreaming about? Make the 
arrangements so it can be handled later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we resumed training and aimed 
for the mountain summit. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was there a landslide? The path was 
blocked by a massive amount of dirt and 
rock for about five meters.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If we go looking for a detour, we'll fall 
far behind schedule.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: So, let us keep going like this.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Take my hand. —We're about to soar.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment Gentildonna scooped me into her 
arms, she cleared the landslide with her 
phenomenal leg power.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the moments before landing on the other 
side of the debris—with the wind against 
my cheeks, I am reminded once again that 
the Umamusume I train is truly 
extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we resume once we've 
stretched?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It is the instinct of every living 
creature to seek the strongest." ...That 
is certainly true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then, if we showcase her strength... 
people are bound to be drawn to her power, 
and from there, become interested in 
racing...!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, did you want to talk about something?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. You wish to draw the public's 
attention with my performance... is that 
it?”
choice_data_list: I know you can do it! So...!
I know you can do it! So...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
True. If the Umamusume racing world lacks 
excitement, no one will come knocking on 
our doors to race.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Becoming the strongest in a closed-off 
world makes one nothing more than a frog 
in a well. Therefore, I have no objections 
to cooperating.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That is, of course, assuming you bring me 
a proposal worthy of my time?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... How delightful. Do be sure to 
give it your absolute best, now.
